title: Alberta L NDE 4582
content: I went through a tunnel and into the brightest light that you can imagine but it was not blinding. It was so calming and filled with love. It was a thousand times better than the love you experience on earth. Everything was white when I passed through the light. I saw a bunch of people dressed in white robes. They were communicating without talking or moving their mouths and floating without walking. A figure came close to me. It was my great grandmother. That was odd because I was not her favorite great granddaughter, my cousin was. I always knew she loved me though. As soon as she came very close to me, my mother came up from behind her and put her hand out to me so I could grab it. My great grandmother prevented that. All of a sudden, I wanted to go back to tell my husband that I wanted him to raise our children a certain way then I wanted to come right back as soon as possible. I really wanted to stay but the urgency to come back to tell my husband about the way I wanted our children to be raised was overwhelming. But what was really overwhelming was my urge to stay where I was. It seemed like a split second that I was going backwards really, really fast back to earth. I was sick for a long time and I would not talk about it. I knew it was real but I figured no one would believe me especially after I had my daughter two years previously and suffered postpartum depression. After that experience, I was no longer afraid to die. At my age now at sixty-three with three children and eight grandchildren, I want to live a longer life (because I am really having a ball being retired) but I no longer fear death. When it comes, I just hope I do not have pain. Where I went, there is no such thing as pain (physically or mentally). There I found the true meaning of unconditional LOVE. Also, the peace that you feel is hard to put in words.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "bunch of people dressed in white robes" floating; communication without moving mouths. A figure came close identified as great grandmother; mother also appeared.

environment.environment_other_detail: Everything was white when she passed through the light.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel into bright, non-blinding light; then white environment with robed people and deceased relatives; then rapid backward return motivated by desire to tell husband how to raise children.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Great grandmother prevented mother from reaching out to her; strong urgency to return specifically to tell husband how to raise their children, then wished to return again soon.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I went through a tunnel and into the brightest light that you can imagine but it was not blinding." "It was so calming and filled with love." "It seemed like a split second that I was going backwards really, really fast back to earth." "After that experience, I was no longer afraid to die." "Where I went, there is no such thing as pain (physically or mentally)."
